**T6.** Multiplicative node (`MultKAN[2→1→1]`, target `exp(-x1)·sin(pi*x2)`), 8 well-converged seeds / 28 pairs / 56 edge-fits, 0 inconclusive (100% of the domain retained on every pair).

**(a) Overall**

| quantity | residual |
| --- | --- |
| affine quotient (full grid) | 0.0324 |
| affine quotient (matched domain) | 0.0324 |
| power quotient | 0.0042 |
| power advantage overall | 7.7× |

**(b) Stratified by |p − 1|.** Affine is the `p=1` slice of the power group, so pairs that land near `p=1` are affine-stable by construction; the two quotients separate only as the exponent leaves that slice. corr(|p−1|, affine residual) = +0.6491.

| \|p − 1\| | n edges | affine residual | power residual | power advantage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [0, 0.15) | 12 | 0.0036 | 0.0019 | 1.9× |
| [0.15, 0.5) | 18 | 0.0087 | 0.0022 | 3.9× |
| [0.5, 1.0) | 10 | 0.0433 | 0.0050 | 8.7× |
| [1.0, ∞) | 16 | 0.0738 | 0.0077 | 9.5× |

**(c) Shared exponent (P3)**

| quantity | value |
| --- | --- |
| within-pair relative \|p1 − p2\| | 0.0135 (1.35%) |
| across-pair SD of p | 1.1628 |
| ratio within / across | 0.0120 |
| observed range of p | [-3.246, 2.404] |

**(d) Prefactors.** `corr(p, log|c1|) = +0.9533` — the fitted prefactor is largely determined by the exponent, not an independent coordinate (see methods: the pre-registered torus test is not identifiable as posed).
